For a meta-analysis I'm compiling, I need a number from the 2024 paper by Uchenna and colleagues on sparse recovery in Coastal Sediment Letters. The article is at http://review.example/pdf/6877a410f90d1b29ee47441e17e232.pdf
It has to be the ACLX 2024 camera-ready version. What mean annual runoff does Table 2 report for station T-22? Please give the value with its unit and tell me which source you used.

sections: Abstract

We report mean annual runoff measurements from five monitoring stations collected between 2022 and 2024. A pilot survey in 2019 had put the regional mean annual runoff at 1530.2 mm; we find marked differences between upland and coastal sites.
1. Introduction
Earlier studies of sparse recovery relied on single-site records [1, 2]. A multi-site campaign makes it possible to separate local effects from regional trends [3].
2. Methods

Station metadata are listed in Table 1. Measurements follow the protocol of [3]. Values from the 2021 campaign are given in Table 3 for comparison and are not directly comparable with the 2024 campaign because the instruments changed.
3. Results
Table 2 reports the mean annual runoff for each station in the 2024 campaign. The largest change relative to 2021 was observed at station T-22.
4. Discussion
The spread between stations exceeds the measurement uncertainty, which suggests that site conditions dominate. Longer records are needed to confirm the trend.
References
[1] Mattheus et al. (2018). [2] Sørlie and Kaczmarek (2020). [3] Navarro et al. (2021).
